YOUR PERSONAL AI

Connect your server

Bring Ollama into your workspace. Your browser connects directly to your server.

Use the base URL, without /api/chat. Remote access needs HTTPS and permission for this site's origin.
Setting up Ollama for the first time
  1. Install Ollama on your server and pull a model, for example ollama pull llama3.2.
  2. For use outside your home, put Ollama behind an authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy or private VPN. Keep port 11434 off the public internet.
  3. Set OLLAMA_ORIGINS to , then restart Ollama. Your proxy must allow CORS and the Authorization header if used.
  4. Enter your reachable server URL above, connect, and choose a model.

Demo mode is a local interface preview; it does not run an AI model. Chat history is stored in this browser. Clear it using the delete button beside a conversation.

TAKE RELAY WITH YOU

Use Relay on your device

Open Relay in a current browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android, iPhone, or iPad. Installation options depend on your browser and OS version.

Windows · Linux · ChromeOS
In Chrome or Edge, open the browser menu and choose Install Relay or Install this site as an app. ChromeOS also adds it to your launcher.
macOS
Use Install in Chrome or Edge. In Safari on macOS Sonoma 14 or later, choose File → Add to Dock.
iPhone · iPad
Open Relay in Safari. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. Enable Open as Web App if offered.
Android
In Chrome, open the browser menu → Add to Home screen → Install. Other browsers may offer a shortcut instead.
Firefox · browsers without Install
Use Relay in a browser tab or bookmark it. App installation is optional; chat and coding work in the browser.

On touch devices, Enter adds a new line; tap the arrow to send. Desktop: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Your server needs reachable HTTPS and CORS permission for this app. Offline mode shows saved chats; AI replies require your server. Very old browsers and embedded in-app browsers may lack streaming or offline features—open Relay in an updated browser.

Talk with Relay

Connect your Ollama server, then tap Start voice below the chat. Speak and pause: Relay sends the recognized words, speaks the reply, and listens again. Tap Stop voice at any time.

Your browser may send audio to its speech-recognition provider. Relay sends only the recognized text to your Ollama server. Browser support, permissions, and spoken playback vary.

Keep Relay open and your phone unlocked. Voice stops when you switch apps or lock the screen. Cookies cannot enable background microphone access.

If voice input is unavailable, use your keyboard's dictation microphone to enter a message, then tap Send.

Cookies & privacy

Relay uses a first-party preference cookie for your selected tab, model names, theme, and voice playback setting. It expires after 180 days. No advertising or analytics cookies are added.

Chat history and server address stay in this browser's local storage. Proxy tokens stay in memory. Neither tokens nor chat messages are placed in cookies. Cookies do not sync devices or keep you signed in to Ollama.

Resetting preferences keeps saved conversations. Delete a conversation using × beside it in Recent.

Plugins

Ponytail

The official coding skills, pinned to version 5.3.3. Applies instructions to your model; it does not install Claude Code hooks or its band/metrics UI.

Use /ponytail lite|full|ultra|off, /ponytail-review, /ponytail-audit, /ponytail-debt, /ponytail-help, or /ponytail-gain. Provide code in chat for reviews; Relay has no repository filesystem access.

Ponytail source →

Playwright

Runs Microsoft's MCP browser tools on your server. Each requested tool action requires your approval. The browser is separate from this phone and uses a temporary isolated profile. Only enable a gateway you control. Direct server/Node code execution is excluded.

Gateway setup is required before browser tools can run. Ollama alone does not provide Playwright.

Uses the gateway's installed Ollama models. Choose one that supports tools. Turning it off restores your direct Ollama connection.

Gateway setup →

Approve browser tools?

These actions run on the gateway browser. Review their full arguments. Page content and model requests can be wrong. Approve only actions you intend.
